findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: estimate_quantity_or_probability, get_estimate_result, list_my_estimates, send_feedback, buy_credits · Private data: get_estimate_result, send_feedback · Public sink: estimate_quantity_or_probability, list_my_estimates, send_feedback, buy_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: estimate_quantity_or_probability, get_estimate_result, list_my_estimates, send_feedback, buy_credits · Private data: get_estimate_result, send_feedback · Public sink: estimate_quantity_or_probability, list_my_estimates, send_feedback, buy_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
